ops.body: - [owner] The `gaps` journey fails on `main` at "gap-drawing audit 4: Done waits for the paths" (3 of 3 runs of `npm run e2e:baseline -- gaps` on `4827a15`, Nov 18; the same on the replay-pace branch): with the fake tiles slowed by 4 s, Draw my way's bar opens already saying "Tap along the way you walked", never "Reading the paths", and Done is not disabled. Not a flake, so not in `scripts/e2e/flaky.json`. Unconfirmed guess at the cause: `main` now keeps the last tile bodies in memory (`createTileBodies`, `discovery/tileBodies.ts`), so the paths of tiles read moments before are at hand and the journey's slow-tiles step no longer makes them wait; then the check is stale rather than the app wrong, but nothing was run to show it. Replay pace was deployed over it on the owner's call (it does not touch gap drawing); the journey ran 19 checks before stopping there, so the checks after it were not run on that build
